claims.text: Exit 0 proves only that the volforecast package resolves from src: the real work is deferred, ExperimentConfig is imported inside main only when a run command executes, so a bare import never touches the config, the models, or the tournament path.

Importing is not testing: this snapshot imports 14 modules that have no file on disk, volforecast.config among them, and the roughly 2,700 tests under src/tests never ran, so the very interpreter that returned 0 here fails the moment vol run asks for ExperimentConfig.
